name: diataxis-docs
description: OneLiteFeather's documentation standard: Diátaxis (tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation) for routing content into the right quadrant, writing each page in the voice its quadrant demands, auditing an overloaded README or wiki, growing a docs set one published improvement at a time, and generating the reference quadrant from source with a CI drift gate. Covers repository Markdown, GitHub wiki, Outline, GitBook and other static-site generators as publishing targets.
